snippet.title: SNES Sougou Kakutougi: Astral Bout 2 - The Total Fighters
snippet.description: The "Astral Bout" trilogy remains a curious entry in the Super Famicom library. Based on Japan's Fighting Network Rings promotion, you can consider this the precursor of today's Mixed Martial Arts tournaments around the world. This sequel improves both graphics and sound, but changes gameplay considerably and I have yet to properly master the grapple controls, but enjoy!
